proposals.title: Option 1: by customer need
proposals.body:
Groups content by what problem the reader is trying to solve. Each section answers a specific question a customer might have.

- Packaging & distribution
- Observability & monitoring
- Security & compliance
- Integration & extensions
proposals.author: facilitator

proposals.title: Option 2: by lifecycle stage
proposals.body:
Good for readers who know what stage they are in. Maps to the journey from first install to long-term operation.

- Develop
- Build & publish
- Deploy
- Operate
- Maintain
proposals.author: facilitator

proposals.title: Option 3: by product area
proposals.body:
Mirrors the internal team structure. Familiar to contributors but may not match how customers think.

- Snap Store
- Snapd
- Snapcraft
- LXD
- Juju
proposals.author: facilitator

proposals.title: Option 4: hybrid (need + product)
proposals.body:
Top level by customer need, second level by product. Balances discoverability for new customers with precision for experienced ones.

- Get started (→ quickstarts per product)
- Build & package (→ Snap, OCI, Charm)
- Deploy & operate (→ Juju, LXD)
- Monitor & secure (→ Observability stack)
proposals.author: facilitator
